policy: Parent round-robin: at most one execution batch (<=64 execution variants) per lease grant.
derivation: Grant membership is the runner journal order between diagnostic-pause records (each marks the runner resuming after a grant was acquired). Controller grant labels count compilations from 1; runner batch ids count from 0.

deviation.cause: The controller re-paused the runner on seeing the next batch compilation record (100 ms poll); the runner passed its between-variants check for the first batch-2 variant before the pause file was written, then acknowledged before the second.
deviation.scheduling: Breach of the <=64-variant/one-batch grant rule, retained as observed; not replayed or retried.
deviation.validity: Every variant, including the 65th, executed while this controller held the exclusive lease and the verified central pause, under LLDB entry/final-exit containment. Conformance observations are unaffected.

remediation: Do not reuse this controller pattern until the boundary race is resolved: pause on the observation count reaching the batch variants count (runner acknowledged boundary), and detect/record any overrun. A strict guarantee needs a runner-side pause-after-batch option; none was built.
